missing_facts: Devon Gray's Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax payment record for the 2025–26 tax year (the year covering the 1 March 2026 donation), to confirm the donor paid at least as much tax as the charity wishes to claim in Gift Aid (25p per £1, i.e. £23.75 on a £95 donation)

A complete and valid Gift Aid declaration from Devon Gray that demonstrably covers the £95 donation made on 1 March 2026 — specifically, the missing pages of the scanned form showing the declaration's scope and duration, or a new declaration from Devon Gray
justification: Seven of the nine required conditions are satisfied on the available evidence: the charity holds valid HMRC recognition (a1); Devon Gray donated from a personal account, confirming an individual donor (a2); the payment is not via Payroll Giving (a5); it is not a payment for goods or services (a6); no benefit was provided to Devon (a7); it is not a donation of shares (a8); and it was not made via a charity card or voucher (a9). However, two conditions remain unresolved. First, a3: the only tax document on file is a P60 for the year ending 5 April 2024, not the 2025–26 tax year in which the donation falls, so it cannot be confirmed that Devon paid sufficient Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax in the relevant year. Second, a4: the Gift Aid declaration on file is a partial scan referencing an earlier gift, with the pages setting out coverage and duration missing; it cannot be established that a valid declaration exists for this specific donation. Because all nine conditions must be met and two are unresolved, the claim cannot proceed on current records.
scope_issues: This assessment covers only the single £95 donation from Devon Gray dated 1 March 2026. Other donations (monthly direct debits from other donors, other one-off gifts) are separate decision units requiring individual assessment.

conditional_branches.conditions_in_words: Gift Aid can be claimed on this donation if (1) Devon Gray's 2025–26 Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax records confirm payment of at least £23.75 (the Gift Aid amount on £95), AND (2) a valid Gift Aid declaration from Devon Gray is located or obtained that covers this donation, whether by finding the missing declaration pages or by obtaining a fresh declaration.

Gift Aid cannot be claimed on this donation if Devon Gray's 2025–26 tax records show insufficient Income Tax or Capital Gains Tax paid, or if no valid Gift Aid declaration covering this donation can be established.
